---
title: "Listing of posts by authors with name particles"
listing:
  id: author-particles
  type: default
  contents: posts
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # particles are part of the displayed name, in CSL order
          - '<div class="listing-author">\s*Frank S\. de Boer, Ludwig van Beethoven\s*</div>'
          # absent name parts are skipped
          - '<div class="listing-author">\s*Aristotle\s*</div>'
---

::: {#author-particles}
:::

Listing items show each author's full name, including the dropping and
non-dropping particles of a structured name, as the post's title block does.
A structured name without a given name shows only the parts it has.
